name: google-map
title: Google Map
description: A reusable Google Maps renderer with paint-aligned responsive radius fitting, centered overlays, accessible touch controls, shared script loading, and localized states.
docs:
## Overview

`GoogleMap` is a product-neutral Google Maps JavaScript renderer. The host owns its browser key, location selection and layout. The component owns shared script loading, centered overlays, camera controls, localized states and cleanup. Install with `bunx shadcn@latest add @krak-stack/google-map`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { GoogleMap } from "@/components/ui/google-map";

<GoogleMap
  apiKey={googleMapsBrowserApiKey}
  center={{ lat: 45.5019, lng: -73.5674 }}
  zoom={9}
  marker={{ icon: "/map-marker.svg" }}
  radius={{ radiusMeters: 25_000, fillColor: "#2563eb", strokeColor: "#1d4ed8" }}
  fitRadius
  fitPadding={40}
  className="h-80 min-h-0 w-full"
  controlsClassName="bg-card shadow-md"
/>
```

Provide a definite height through `className`; the default minimum height is 16rem. Dialog width, responsive columns, keyboard-safe content scrolling and action layout remain host concerns.

## Control styling

`controlsClassName` customizes the camera-control surface without changing the map, marker or radius. Stable data slots are `google-map`, `google-map-canvas`, `google-map-controls` and `google-map-control`. Use these hooks for host-owned colours and hover/focus styling instead of editing installed source. Retain 44px touch targets, visible focus and clear attribution.

## Responsive radius fitting

`fitRadius` defaults to false, preserving controlled center/zoom behavior. When enabled with a radius, Google bounds fitting keeps the complete circle visible with `fitPadding` pixels (default 32). Fitting runs after initialization, location/radius changes and actual nonzero container-size changes. Hidden maps fit when revealed through ResizeObserver. Manual zoom remains until those changes or the Show selected area action; styling-only overlay changes do not reset the camera. Supplied minZoom/maxZoom still constrain the camera. Extremely large padding or restrictive zoom limits can prevent full visibility.

The 44px zoom and selected-area controls have visible keyboard focus and sit above the map, away from bottom attribution. Set `zoomControls={false}` to hide these custom controls. `interactive={false}` disables dragging, gestures, scrolling, keyboard shortcuts and clickable map icons while retaining optional custom controls.

## Overlays and localization

`marker` accepts a boolean or custom icon URL object. Radius values are meters; fillColor, fillOpacity, strokeColor, strokeOpacity and strokeWeight customize the centered circle. Set the active locale with KrakstackProvider, or override `locale`. The `messages` map supports arbitrary locale keys, with exact locale, base language and English fallback; English and French include loading, unavailable, zoom and selected-area labels.

## Ajustement adaptatif

Activez `fitRadius` pour cadrer le cercle entier à l’ouverture, lors d’un changement de lieu ou de rayon et après un redimensionnement réel. `fitPadding` définit la marge en pixels. Le zoom manuel est conservé jusqu’à ces changements ou à l’action Afficher la zone sélectionnée. Les boutons mesurent 44px et offrent un focus clavier visible. Le conteneur et la disposition de la fenêtre restent sous la responsabilité de l’application. `controlsClassName` et les attributs `data-slot` permettent de personnaliser les contrôles sans modifier le composant installé. Conservez les cibles tactiles de 44px, le focus visible et les mentions Google.

## API key and lifecycle

Use a browser key with Google Maps JavaScript API enabled and allowed-referrer restrictions. Never pass a server secret. The component reads no environment configuration. Instances share a script and should use the same key. Loading, missing-key and initialization/script failures are localized; remount to retry a failed script. Google Maps attribution, availability, billing and terms remain applicable.
